"""Exercise the final trace validator on a complete, timestamped live prefix."""

import hashlib
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save
from v175_training_trace_audit import validate_trace

repo = Path("/home/dllu/proj/demosaic")
root = repo / ".cache/quality-20261107/V175-fresh-noise-matching-v2"
output = repo / "docs/results/v175-continuation-trace-audit-v1.json"
assert not output.exists()
plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
guard(plan)
owner = read(root / "train-launch-v1.json")["owner"]
process = psutil.Process(owner["pid"])
assert process.create_time() == owner["created"] and process.status() not in [psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE, psutil.STATUS_DEAD]
raw = (root / "train-trace-v1.jsonl").read_bytes()
trace_bytes = raw[:raw.rfind(b"\n") + 1]
trace = [json.loads(s) for s in trace_bytes.splitlines()]
last = trace[-1]["step"]
event_raw = (root / "train-forward-events-v1.jsonl").read_bytes()
event_lines = event_raw[:event_raw.rfind(b"\n") + 1].splitlines(keepends=True)
event_bytes = b"".join(line for line in event_lines if json.loads(line)["step"] <= last)
events = [json.loads(s) for s in event_bytes.splitlines()]
cache = read(plan["cache"]["path"])["batches"]
units = read(plan["pair_units"]["path"])["rows"]
eligible = read(plan["clean_sensor_preflight"]["path"])["rows"]
old = read(plan["initial_training"]["path"])["trace"]
audit = validate_trace(trace, cache, units, eligible, old, events, plan)
assert len(trace) > 100 and audit["updates"] > 90
assert psutil.Process(owner["pid"]).create_time() == owner["created"]
save(output, dict(status="pass-shared-final-trace-validator-on-actual-live-prefix",
    observed_unix_UTC=time.time(), owner=owner, owner_confirmed_live=True,
    plan=ref(root / "plan-v1.json"), continuation_rows=len(trace), last_total_row=last,
    new_updates=audit["updates"], ADC_skips=audit["skips"], fresh_sensor_batches=audit["fresh"], cached_noisy_batches=audit["cached"],
    matching_counts=audit["counts"], parent_counts_including_two_replays=audit["parent_counts"],
    FP32_loss_totals_checked=audit["totals"], maximum_loss_total_difference=audit["maximum_difference"],
    inherited_clean_masks_checked=audit["masks"], observed_parent_argument_fingerprints_checked=audit["observed_arguments"],
    training_forward_events_checked=len(events), unique_fresh_sensor_seeds=len(audit["seeds"]),
    training_journal_prefix=dict(path=str(root / "train-trace-v1.jsonl"), bytes=len(trace_bytes), sha256=hashlib.sha256(trace_bytes).hexdigest()),
    training_event_journal_prefix=dict(path=str(root / "train-forward-events-v1.jsonl"), bytes=len(event_bytes), sha256=hashlib.sha256(event_bytes).hexdigest()),
    sources=[dict(ref(p), text=p.read_text()) for p in [Path(__file__), repo / ".cache/v175_training_trace_audit.py"]],
    new_neural_forwards=0, new_sensor_noise_draws=0,
    scope="Partial actual live training,not final performance or completed training. The same validator will check the final9000-row stream. Prefix byte lengths/hashes bind exactly the complete rows/events observed;later appends do not invalidate those prefixes. Fresh arrays outside the seven saved batches are streamed fingerprints,not independently reconstructed full arrays. No sensor noise regenerated or model/parent/DINO/sampler calls repeated. Owner liveness is timestamp-specific."))
print("PASS shared validator on", len(trace), "live rows,", audit["updates"], "updates,", audit["fresh"], "fresh batches;zero extra inference/noise")

"""Audit actual continuation rows/events without regenerating noise or running a model."""
import hashlib
import math
from collections import Counter
import numpy as np


def validate_trace(trace, cache, units, eligible, old, events, plan):
    counts = dict(wrapper=0, frozen=0, network=0, sampler=0)
    parent_counts = dict(parent=2, DINO=2)
    cursor = updates = skips = fresh = cached = totals = masks = observed_arguments = 0
    poisson = gaussian = 0
    domains = Counter()
    seeds = set()
    maximum_difference = 0.0
    
    
    def event(name, step):
        nonlocal cursor
        value = events[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        assert value["event"] == name and value["step"] == step
        return value
    
    
    for row_number, row in enumerate(trace, 1):
        index = (row_number - 1) % 1000
        item, permitted = cache[index], eligible[index]
        assert row["continuation_row"] == row_number and row["step"] == 1000 + row_number
        assert row["cache_step"] == index + 1 and row["scene_pass"] == 1 + (row_number - 1) // 1000
        assert row["original_batch"] == item["arrays"] and row["original_parent"] == item["parent"]
        assert row["noisy"] == permitted["noisy"] and row["fresh_noise_eligible"] == permitted["fresh_noise_eligible"]
        assert row["domain"] == item["metadata"]["domain"]
        domains[row["domain"]] += 1
        progress = max(0, row_number - 100) / 8900
        lr = 0.0001 * min(1, row_number / 100) * (0.1 + 0.9 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * progress)) / 2)
        assert lr == row["lr"]
        if not row["noisy"]:
            skips += 1
            assert "terms" not in row and "sensor_draw" not in row
            assert row["skipped"].startswith("ADC row retained")
            assert row["updates"] == updates and row["counts"] == counts and row["parent_counts"] == parent_counts
            continue
        for key in item["inputs"]:
            if key not in ["packed", "variance"]:
                assert row["inputs"][key] == item["inputs"][key]
        if row["fresh_noise_eligible"]:
            fresh += 1
            token = f"V175-fresh-sensor:17501:{row_number}:{index + 1}".encode()
            seed = int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(token).digest()[:8], "little") % 2**63
            assert row["sensor_draw"]["seed"] == seed and seed not in seeds
            seeds.add(seed)
            expected_poisson = 3 if len(units[index]["candidate_units_FP32"]) else 1
            assert row["sensor_draw"] == dict(seed=seed, Poisson_calls=expected_poisson, Gaussian_calls=1, ADC_reused=False)
            poisson += expected_poisson
            gaussian += 1
            assert row["actual_parent_inputs"] == {
                k: row["inputs"][k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb", "matrix"]
            }
            observed_arguments += 5
            assert event("before-parent", row["step"])["parent_counts"] == parent_counts
            parent_counts = {k: v + 1 for k, v in parent_counts.items()}
            returned = event("returned-parent", row["step"])
            assert returned["parent_counts"] == parent_counts and returned["values"] == row["parent_values"]
        else:
            cached += 1
            assert row["cache_step"] in [65, 358, 543]
            assert row["sensor_draw"]["seed"] is None and row["sensor_draw"]["Poisson_calls"] == row["sensor_draw"]["Gaussian_calls"] == 0
            assert row["inputs"] == item["inputs"] and row["parent_values"] == item["parent_values"]
        assert event("before-matching", row["step"])["counts"] == counts
        updates += 1
        counts = dict(wrapper=updates, frozen=updates, network=updates, sampler=5 * updates)
        returned = event("returned-matching", row["step"])
        assert returned["counts"] == counts and returned["frozen_values"]["shape"] == row["inputs"]["target"]["shape"]
        assert row["counts"] == counts and row["parent_counts"] == parent_counts and row["updates"] == updates
        terms = {k: np.float32(v) for k, v in row["terms"].items()}
        value = np.float32(terms["pixel"] + np.float32(0.25) * terms["gradient"])
        for term in [terms["local_regret"], terms["DC_regret"], np.float32(0.25) * terms["flat_anchor"], terms["pair_difference"], terms["pair_common"]]:
            value = np.float32(value + term)
        expected = float(np.float32(np.float32(plan["domain_weights"][row["domain"]]) * value))
        difference = abs(expected - row["loss"])
        assert difference == 0
        maximum_difference = max(maximum_difference, difference)
        totals += 1
        assert row["flat_mask"] == old[index]["flat_mask"] and row["flat_eligible_pixels"] == old[index]["flat_eligible_pixels"]
        masks += 1
    assert cursor == len(events)
    return dict(counts=counts, parent_counts=parent_counts, updates=updates, skips=skips, fresh=fresh, cached=cached,
                totals=totals, masks=masks, observed_arguments=observed_arguments, poisson=poisson, gaussian=gaussian,
                domains=domains, seeds=seeds, maximum_difference=maximum_difference, cursor=cursor)
